exact: meiosis I, homologous chromosome movement towards spindle pole
related: homologous chromosome movement towards spindle pole during meiosis I

definition: The directed movement of homologous chromosomes from the center of the spindle towards the spindle poles, mediated by the shortening of microtubules attached to the chromosomes, during meiosis I anaphase.
label: homologous chromosome movement towards spindle pole in meiosis I anaphase
